LightningComponentBundle.description: All three screens of the Create Gift Voucher flow, chosen by Screen Mode: offer specifications, dynamic record filtering with selection, and voucher details.

property.name: offerType
property.label: Offer Type
property.description: Fixed Price or Percentage. Map in and out.

property.name: minAmount
property.label: Min Amount
property.description: Minimum bill amount as text; blank means 0. Map in and out.

property.name: maxAmount
property.label: Max Amount
property.description: Maximum bill amount as text. Map in and out.

property.name: offerAmount
property.label: Offer Amount
property.description: Fixed Price amount as text. Map in and out.

property.name: discountPercentage
property.label: Discount Percentage
property.description: Percentage off as text. Map in and out.

property.name: objectAPIName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object whose records are filtered, e.g. Account.

property.name: columnFields
property.label: Table Columns
property.description: Comma-separated field API names shown in the results table, e.g. Name,CASA_ID__c,CLV__c.

property.name: ruleListJSON
property.label: Rule List
property.description: The rules built on screen. Map in and out so they survive Previous.

property.name: ruleLogic
property.label: Rule Logic
property.description: Rule logic such as 1 AND (2 OR 3). Map in and out.

property.name: selectedRecordIds
property.label: Selected Record Ids
property.description: Ids of the ticked records. Map in and out.

property.name: voucherCode
property.label: Voucher Code
property.description: Voucher code prefix. Map in and out.
